requirements.description: The user wants an energy class C or better, so the filter includes A1 through A4, B and C. The floor area, capacity, Turin location, public transport proximity and CDP/PNRR funding criteria are not energy columns and were not extracted.

The user asks for a location near public transport. Per the 75th percentile of the mobility distribution (70.93, rounded to 71), this sets a strong proximity threshold for metro, bus, and station access.

A university student residence clearly needs nearby universities and schools. The 75th percentile of the education distribution is 75.14, rounded to 75, so the site should be close to educational facilities.
The user explicitly requires a gross floor area of at least 850 sqm.

output.explanation: Filters on the extracted requirements only: property_type 'Uffici e assimilabili', surface_area >= 850, energy_class in A1-A4/B/C, a 3.0 km haversine radius around (45.0677551, 7.6824892), mobility >= 71 and education >= 75. Results are ordered by distance from that point. The capacity of 60 people has no matching column, so it is not filtered.
